# Garden hello

A sample note inside the garden folder for MDFriday Digital Garden vault smoke.

- Built against **staging**
- Guest content TTL ≈ **7 days** rolling
- No account required for the first publish

## Checklist

- [ ] Ribbon icon is a two-pip die (`dice-2`)
- [ ] Right-click the `Garden` folder publishes successfully
- [ ] URL host is `share.fsky.top`
- [ ] UI shows expiry ≈ 7 days (when API returns `expiresAt`)
- [ ] Site chrome / theme / History tabs are available (not Share-thin)
